g.text: Which TNC or modem kissterm talks to. Changing this reopens the connection, so disconnect first. USB
and serial TNCs are noticed automatically when you plug them in; scanning the network is manual,
because a sweep is around 1500 connection attempts and does not belong on a timer.
Who you are on the air.
Your callsign with SSID. Also changeable any time with Ctrl+K.
Extra callsigns this station accepts connections on, comma separated -- a
